title: The Window Boxes Hooked On
youtube_title: The Window Boxes Hooked On | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Finishing together matters more than finishing first.
summary: At a garden row with string and two watering cans, a window box that needed a holder and a hooker will go wrong if one person rushes. Yelena and Zia split it into two slow jobs, while Miss Dalca only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
